title: Jungle's Air Challenge
description: this mod kills you whenever the block at your coordinates is `air`
body:
*Very very funny and wholesome experience*  

This mod simply kills you whenever the block at your coordinates is `air`  
I raccomend having the gamerule `immediate_respawn` enabled to make the respawning process not last ages  

This mode has been made for those that are looking for a real challenge, but most importantly, are willing to lose hours of progress due to very small mistakes
